payload.transcriptText: happened. Last week. We tested the exact same landing page with one small change. The first version converted at 2.8%. The second converted at 5.1%. We didn't change the product, we didn't change the pricing. We only changed where people looked first. And that's when everything started making sense. Imagine taking a walk into a store where the entrance points you towards the checkout instead of the shelves. That's basically what happened.
